name: f03-multi-entity
description: SYNTHETIC. Two candidate appointment slots plus a place, in one utterance. Several distinct times, numbers and a location — the entity-count gate signal.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: 次の予約ですが、来週の火曜日の10時半か、木曜日の14時が空いています。どちらも3階の受付に来ていただく形になります。

expect.notes: Both slots must survive. Collapsing to one is an over-reduction failure: the person can no longer choose.
